channel.title: The PHP Dictionary — Recent Changes
channel.description: Recently added or updated entries in the PHP Dictionary.

item.title: Green Thread
item.description: Green threads, also called ``goroutines`` in Go, virtual threads in Java 21+, or lightweight threads in Erlang/Haskell, are user-space threads managed entirely by the language runtime rather than the operating system kernel.

item.title: Move Semantics
item.description: Move semantics, central to C++11 and Rust, let a value's underlying resources be transferred from a source object to a destination object instead of copied, when the source is about to be discarded anyway, such as a temporary or a variable passed by value into a function.

item.title: move_uploaded_file()
item.description: ``move_uploaded_file()`` is a native PHP function that moves a file that was uploaded via an HTTP POST request to a new destination.

item.title: Multiple Return Values
item.description: Some languages, such as ``Go`` and ``Lua``, let a function return several values directly, separated by commas, without wrapping them in a container.

item.title: PHP Natives
item.description: PHP offers a selection of natives, which are not directly derived from a class, interface or enumeration name.

item.title: WeakReference
item.description: ``WeakReference`` is a final class that holds a reference to an object without keeping that object alive.

item.title: Reference Count
item.description: Reference counting is the way PHP keeps track of the usage of a value.

item.title: Polling API
item.description: The Polling API is a PHP 8.

item.title: POSIX
item.description: ``posix`` is a PHP extension that gives access to functions defined in the IEEE 1003.

item.title: pathinfo()
item.description: ``pathinfo()`` is a native PHP function that returns information about a file path:

item.title: Decrement
item.description: Decrement refers to the process of decreasing or subtracting a small amount from a value, or simply one unit.

item.title: clamp()
item.description: ``clamp()`` is a native PHP function that limits a value to a range.

item.title: stream_select()
item.description: ``stream_select()`` is a native PHP function that waits until one or more streams are ready for reading, writing, or have an exceptional condition, using the system ``select()`` call.

item.title: Polling
item.description: Polling is a technique where a script repeatedly checks the status of a resource or condition at regular intervals, until a result is available or a timeout is reached.

item.title: Non-blocking
item.description: Non-blocking I/O, applied to a non-blocking stream, is a mode where read and write operations return immediately, even if no data is available or the buffer is full, instead of suspending execution until the operation can complete.

item.title: array_change_key_case()
item.description: ``array_change_key_case()`` is a native PHP function that returns a copy of an array where all the string keys are converted to lowercase or uppercase.

item.title: array_map()
item.description: ``array_map()`` is a PHP native function that applies a closure to every element of an array.

item.title: Directives
item.description: Directives are the configuration option of PHP.

item.title: file_get_contents()
item.description: ``file_get_contents()`` is a PHP native function, which reads all data from a file, in one call.

item.title: Network
item.description: A network is a collection of computers, linked together with communication capabilities.

item.title: Stream
item.description: Streams are a generalisation of the notion of files.

item.title: stream_context_create()
item.description: ``stream_context_create()`` is a native PHP function that creates a stream context:

item.title: max_filter_count
item.description: ``max_filter_count`` is a stream context option that limits how many filters can be chained in a single ``php:

item.title: disable_functions
item.description: The ``disable_functions`` PHP directive prevents specific native functions from being called by the code.

item.title: Pipeline
item.description: A pipeline is a chain of steps that composes a sequential set of actions.

item.title: String Increment
item.description: String increment is the PHP feature that applies the ``++`` pre- and post-increment operators on non-numeric strings.

item.title: Duration
item.description: The ``Time\Duration`` class is a PHP 8.

item.title: Base Conversion
item.description: Base conversion turns an integer written in one numeric base into the same value written in another base.

item.title: Socket Extension
item.description: ``sockets`` is the PHP extension that provides the low-level socket functions, such as ``socket_create()``, ``socket_bind()``, ``socket_listen()``, ``socket_accept()``, ``socket_connect()`` and ``socket_read()``.

item.title: Socket
item.description: A socket refers to a communication endpoint that allows two processes to exchange data over a network.

item.title: Stream Filter
item.description: A stream filter is a piece of code attached to a stream, which transforms the data as it is read from or written to that stream.

item.title: define()
item.description: ``define()`` is a PHP function that introduces global constant definitions.

item.title: Supply Chain
item.description: The supply chain is the set of components, libraries, tools and processes that are used to build an application.

item.title: Tabulation
item.description: A tabulation is a whitespace character, that often represents the equivalent of four space characters.

item.title: Trace
item.description: A trace is the list of called functions during an execution.

item.title: Cast Operator
item.description: Cast operators change the type of the variable to the desired type.

item.title: json_decode()
item.description: ``json_decode()`` decodes a JSON string into a data structure.

item.title: Multibyte String
item.description: ``mbstring`` is the PHP extension dedicated to processing multibyte character strings, that is, text encoded in character sets where a single character can occupy more than one byte, such as UTF-8, UTF-16, EUC-JP, Shift-JIS, or Big5.

item.title: Type Juggling
item.description: Type juggling is the emblematic PHP feature, where data has no specific type definition, and its type may change depending on the situation.

item.title: Inter-Process Communication (IPC)
item.description: Inter-process communication, or IPC, is the set of mechanisms an operating system offers for two separate processes to exchange data or coordinate their work, since processes do not share memory with each other by default.

item.title: parse_ini_string()
item.description: ``parse_ini_string()`` parses a string formatted like a PHP ini file, and returns its settings as an associative array, the same way ``parse_ini_file()`` does for a file on disk.

item.title: mb_substr()
item.description: ``mb_substr()`` extracts a portion of a string, counting positions in characters rather than in bytes, so it works correctly on multibyte text such as UTF-8.

item.title: strlen()
item.description: ``strlen()`` returns the number of bytes in a string, not the number of characters it displays as.

item.title: str_split()
item.description: ``str_split()`` splits a string into an array of chunks of a fixed byte length, one character per chunk by default.

item.title: get_debug_type()
item.description: ``get_debug_type()`` returns the type of a value as a string, using the same names that appear in type declarations, rather than the historical names used by ``gettype()``.

item.title: settype()
item.description: ``settype()`` converts a variable to a given type, in place, modifying the variable itself rather than returning a converted copy.

item.title: feof()
item.description: ``feof()`` checks whether the end of a file has been reached for a given file pointer, returning true once no more data can be read from it.

item.title: Urbanisation
item.description: Urbanisation is the practice of organising an information system the way a city planner organises a city:

item.title: RdKafka
item.description: ``rdkafka`` is a PIE extension providing a PHP client for Apache ``Kafka``, a distributed event-streaming platform.

item.title: Test
item.description: Tests are tools that monitor the behavior of a code.
